entry.name: rnbo_midiflush
entry.digest: Track MIDI note on state and send note offs with a bang
entry.description: Analyzes a raw MIDI stream, counting the number of note-ons received for each note and MIDI channel. When it is sent a bang, MIDI note-off messages are sent for any notes which have not been turned off.
